fields.Name: T192 - Admin API Keys Section
fields.Description: Opens the Admin app's Identity & Access section and navigates to the API Keys sub-section. Verifies the API Keys view renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) - the pinned app list is short and Admin is visible without scrolling. Open the 'Identity & Access' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'API Keys' sub-section. The success state is the API Keys view rendered, showing a list/grid of API key entries OR a valid empty-state (e.g. a prompt to create a key). This is a platform view that may have sparse data in a fresh regression DB, so accept an empty-state as long as the API Keys view renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for the view to render rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin application is active and the Identity & Access section is open
The API Keys sub-section is selected and its view renders a list/grid or a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
